headline: Sudarshan Colorants India Limited files SEBI SAST Regulation 10 exemption disclosure
sum: Sudarshan Colorants India Limited submitted to NSE a disclosure under SEBI (SAST) Regulations Reg 10(6) reporting an acquisition undertaken in reliance on exemption under Regulation 10 of the SAST framework.
detail: Sudarshan Colorants filed a Regulation 10(6) disclosure with NSE (Indian stock exchange), which is the mandatory reporting instrument for acquisitions undertaken under an exemption to SEBI's Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers (SAST) Regulations 2011. The exemptions under Reg 10 permit acquisition without a public open offer in narrow cases: acquisitions by promoters, acquisition of shares in concert, creeping acquisition within permissible thresholds, or acquisitions pursuant to court/regulatory order. The specific exemption invoked and the transaction details remain unretrieved.
